value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical nonplanar bridgeless cubic graph immediately outside the hypotheses of the recent outerplanar wedge theorem. A mixed-dimensional integral homotopy classification is more informative than Betti numbers and is not implied by that theorem. The full natural S5 action distinguishes a signed five-point permutation module in degree two from an irreducible five-dimensional Specht module in degree three, furnishing structural information and a reproducible benchmark for matching-complex symmetry beyond the outerplanar setting. No sweeping all-graph conjecture is claimed.
